description:
Who is really buying from an x402 seller on Base: each payer that opened a payment channel with the seller's escrow, and how many channels each opened. It counts the payers, not the relayers that submit their transactions.
A call without a line has only a moment, enough for a small range of recent blocks, and is cut, uncharged, when it needs longer. from_block is a block number and defaults to the whole history; Base adds about 43,200 blocks a day. The first answer says how many windows the scan will take and, at the pace of recent scans, how many milliseconds it likely takes (likely_ms) and at most (about_ms, the time a line should hold), and each one after says how many are done and what the rest needs.
Paid, on a line: $0.000001 per millisecond. With no wallet code, ZEAM :: Pass buys the time and opens the line: a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay).
Example: {"contract":"0x4020074e9dF2ce1deE5A9C1b5c3f541D02a10003","from_block":51000000}

contract.description: string — an x402 settlement escrow, 0x form.

from_block.description: optional int — first block; default the whole history. To continue a partial answer, keep it and set to_block one below its scanned.from.

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

receiver.description: optional string — only channels paying this receiver; omit for all.

to_block.description: optional int — stop; default the head.

window.description: optional int — blocks per snapshot, default 10000; smaller lands the first snapshot sooner.
